detail.title: Intex Cool Star HC 50  Desert Air Cooler – 50 Litres
detail.overview: Compact Cooling | Energy-Efficient Performance | Inverter-Compatible | Ice Chamber | 1-Year Warranty Overview The Intex Cool Star HC 50 is a compact and efficient desert air cooler designed for dependable cooling in small to medium-sized spaces. Ideal for daily home use, this model offers effective airflow, low power consumption, and easy maintenance — making it a practical choice for beating summer heat without complexity. With a 50-litre water tank, the HC 50 provides several hours of uninterrupted cooling, reducing the need for frequent refills. Its high-efficiency honeycomb cooling pads retain 45% more water, which results in 25% extra cooling. The efficient fan system ensures steady air circulation across the room for uniform cooling. Built for convenience and reliability, the Cool Star HC 50 is inverter compatible, allowing continued operation during power cuts. A built-in ice chamber enhances cooling when temperatures peak, while the shock- and rust-proof body ensures long-term durability. Its compact footprint and easy mobility make it well-suited for everyday indoor use. Product Highlights 50-Litre Water Tank for Efficient Daily Use The compact tank capacity supports extended cooling sessions for smaller spaces while keeping refilling simple and manageable. High-Efficiency Honeycomb Cooling Pads These pads improve water retention and evaporation, resulting in effective cooling performance in dry summer conditions. Inverter-Compatible Operation Designed to operate on home inverters, the cooler continues to function smoothly during power outages. Ice Chamber for Enhanced Cooling The integrated ice chamber allows for a noticeable drop in air temperature during extremely hot days. Durable, Rust-Proof Body The shock- and rust-resistant construction ensures reliability and long-lasting performance. Ideal For Bedrooms, study rooms, small living rooms, and compact home spaces that require efficient cooling in a space-saving design.
